senses: place or means of safety, protection, refuge, stronghold
place of safety, fastness, harbour, stronghold

strongs.def: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
strongs.kjv: force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), ([idiom] most) strong (hold)
strongs.from: (also מָעוּז ); or מָעֹז (also מָעֻז; from H5810 (עָזַז)
